normalize_pet(pet):\n    p1, p99 = np.percentile(pet, 1), np.percentile(pet, 99)\n    x = np.clip(pet, p1, p99)\n    x = (x - p1) / (p99 - p1 + 1e-6)\n    return x.astype(np.float32)\n\ndef ToTensorV2(),\n])\n\nclass PETCTFusionDataset(Dataset):\n    def __init__(self, pids, samples_per_patient, is_train=True, tfms=None):\n        self.pids = list(pids)\n        self.spp = int(samples_per_patient)\n        self.is_train = bool(is_train)\n        self.tfms = tfms\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        return len(self.pids) * self.spp\n\n    def _pick_pet_index(self, pid, k):\n        n = len(patient_index[pid][\"PT\"])\n        if n == 0:\n            return None\n        if self.is_train:\n            # randomized sampling for robustness\n            rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED + hash((pid, k)) % (2**31-1))\n            return int(rng.randint(0, n))\n        else:\n            # deterministic, covers the whole volume more evenly\n            if self.spp == 1:\n                return n // 2\n            t = k / (self.spp - 1)\n            return int(round(t * (n - 1)))\n\n    def _match_ct_to_pet(self, pid, pet_slice):\n        ct_slices = patient_index[pid][\"CT\"]\n        if len(ct_slices) == 0:\n            return None\n\n        z_pet = pet_slice.get(\"z\", None)\n        # use z-based nearest match if possible\n        if z_pet is not None and any(s.get(\"z\", None) is not None for s in ct_slices):\n            z_list = np.array([s[\"z\"] if s[\"z\"] is not None else 1e18 for s in ct_slices], dtype=np.float64)\n            j =  if os.path.exists(tmp_path):\n            try: os.remove(tmp_path)\n            except: pass\n\ndef safe_pickle_load(path: Path):\n    path = Path(path)\n    if not path.exists():\n        return return c\n\n\n# -----------------------\n# Traditional fusion baselines\n# -----------------------\ndef pca_fuse(a, b):\n    x = np.stack([a.reshape(-1), b.reshape(-1)], axis=1).astype(np.float32)\n    x = x - x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)\n    cov = (x.T @ x) / max(1, x.shape[0] - 1)\n    vals, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    pc1 = vecs[:, np.argmax(vals)]\n    fused = pc1[0] * a + pc1[1] * b\n    fused = fused - fused.min()\n    fused = fused / (fused.max() + 1e-6)\n    return fused.astype(np.float32)\n\ndef laplacian_pyramid_fuse(a, b, levels=3):\n    a = a.astype(np.float32)\n    b = b.astype(np.float32)\n\n    gpA = [a]; gpB = [b]\n    for _ in range(levels):\n        gpA.append(cv2.pyrDown(gpA[-1]))\n        gpB.append(cv2.pyrDown(gpB[-1]))\n\n    lpA = [gpA[-1]]; lpB = dstsize=sizeA)\n        GB = cv2.pyrUp(gpB[i], dstsize=sizeB)\n        lpA.append(gpA[i-1] - GA)\n        lpB.append(gpB[i-1] - GB)\n\n    LS = []\n    for k,(la,lb) in enumerate(zip(lpA, lpB)):\n        if la.shape != lb.shape:\n            lb = cv2.resize(lb, (la.shape[1], la.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)\n        if k == 0:\n            ls = 0.5*la + 0.5*lb\n        else:\n  inter = float(getattr(pt_ds, \"RescaleIntercept\", 0.0))\n                pet_raw = pt_arr * slope + inter\n                pet = normalize_pet(pet_raw)\n                pet = cv2.resize(pet, (W, H), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)\n            else:\n                pet = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.float32)\n\n            bb = patient_index[pid][\"ct_idx2bbox\"].get(ct_idx, None)\n            if bb is not None:\n                x0y0x1y1 = expand_bbox(bb[\"xmin\"], bb[\"ymin\"], bb[\"xmax\"], bb[\"ymax\"], H, W, scale=1.8, min_size=96)\n            else:\n                lung_mask = get_lung_mask_from_hu(hu)\n                bbm = bbox_from_mask(lung_mask)\n                if USE_PET:\n                    thr = np.percentile(pet, 99.5)\n                    thr = max(thr, 0.75)\n                    pet_mask = (pet >= thr).astype(np.uint8)\n                    comb = (pet_mask & lung_mask).astype(np.uint8)\n                    bbm2 = bbox_from_mask(comb) or bbox_from_mask(pet_mask) or bbm\n                    bbm = bbm2\n\n                if bbm is None:\n                    x0y0x1y1 = None\n                else:\n                    x0y0x1y1 = expand_bbox(*bbm, H=H, W=W, scale=1.7, min_size=96)\n\n            if x0y0x1y1 is None:\n                cx, cy = W//2, H//2\n                side = max(96, int(min(H,W)*0.45))\n                x0 = max(0, cx-side//2); x1 = min(W, cx+side//2)\n                y0 = max(0, cy-side//2); y1 = min(H, cy+side//2)\n            else:\n                x0, y0, x1, y1 = x0y0x1y1\n\n            ct_lung_c = crop(ct_lung, x0, y0, x1, y1)\n            ct_med_c  = crop(ct_med,  x0, y0, x1, y1)\n            pet_c     = crop(pet,     x0, y0, x1, y1)\n\n            if FUSION_INPUT == \"stack\":\n                x = np.stack([ct_lung_c, ct_med_c, pet_c], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)\n            elif FUSION_INPUT == \"pca\":\n                fused = pca_fuse(ct_lung_c, pet_c)\n                x = np.stack([ct_lung_c, fused, pet_c], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)\n            elif FUSION_INPUT == \"laplacian\":\n                fused = laplacian_pyramid_fuse(ct_lung_c, pet_c, levels=3)\n                x = np.stack([ct_lung_c, fused, pet_c], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)\n            else:\n                raise ValueError(\"Unknown FUSION_INPUT\")\n\n            x = np.clip(x, 0, 1)\n\n            if self.is_train and random.random() < 0.20:\n                g = random.uniform(0.85, 1.15)\n                x[..., :2] = np.clip(x[..., :2] ** g, 0, 1)\n\n            if self.tfms is not None:\n                out = self.tfms(image=x)\n                x_t = out[\"image\"]\n            else:\n                x_t = torch.from_numpy(x.transpose(2,0,1))\n\n            x_t = (x_t - IMAGENET_MEAN) / (IMAGENET_STD + 1e-6)\n            return x_t, torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.long), pid\n\n        x_t = torch.zeros((3, IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), dtype=torch.float32)\n        return x_t, torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.long), pid\n\n\ntrain_ds = TumorCentricFusionDataset(train_pids, SAMPLES_PER_PATIENT_TRAIN, is_train=True, tfms=train_tfms)\nval_ds   = TumorCentricFusionDataset(val_pids,   SAMPLES_PER_PATIENT_VAL,   is_train=False, tfms=val_tfms)\n\ntrain_labels = [patient_index[pid][\"task_label\"] for pid in train_pids]\ncounts = np.bincount(train_labels, minlength=len(TASK_CLASS_NAMES)).astype(np.float32)\nclass_w = counts.sum() / (counts + 1e-6)\nclass_w = class_w / class_w.mean()\n\nsample_w = []\nfor i in range(len(train_ds)):\n    pid = train_ds.pids[i // train_ds.spp]\n    lab = patient_index[pid][\"task_label\"]\n    sample_w.append(float(class_w[lab]))\n\nsampler = WeightedRandomSampler(sample_w, num_samples=len(sample_w), replacement=True)\n\ntrain_loader = DataLoader(\n    train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, sampler=sampler,\n    num_workers=NUM_WORKERS, pin_memory=(DEVICE.type==\"cuda\"), drop_last=True\n)\n\nval_loader = DataLoader(\n    val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False,\n    num_workers=NUM_WORKERS, pin_memory=(DEVICE.type==\"cuda\")\n)\n\nprint(\"Train batches:\", len(train_loader), \"Val batches:\", len(val_loader))\n\n\n# -----------------------\n# Models\n# -----------------------\ndef create_backbone(backbone, in_chans, pretrained=True, num_classes=0):\n    try:\n        m = timm.create_model(backbone, pretrained=pretrained, in_chans=in_chans, num_classes=num_classes)\n        return m\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(\"⚠️ Pretrained weights unavailable. Using pretrained=False.\", e)\n        m = timm.create_model(backbone, pretrained=False, in_chans=in_chans, num_classes=num_classes)\n        return m\n\nclass EarlyFusionNet(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, backbone, n_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.net = create_backbone(backbone, in_chans=3, pretrained=True, num_classes=n_classes)\n    def forward(self, x):\n        return self.net(x)\n\nclass FeatureFusionCrossAttn(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, backbone, n_classes, heads=8, dropout=0.2):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.ct_enc = create_backbone(backbone, in_chans=2, pretrained=True, num_classes=0)\n        self.pt_enc = create_backbone(backbone, in_chans=1, pretrained=True, num_classes=0)\n\n        d = getattr(self.ct_enc, \"num_features\", None)\n        if d is None:\n            d = self.ct_enc.get_classifier().in_features\n\n        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)\n        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim=d, num_heads=heads, batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)\n        self.head = nn.Sequential(\n            nn.Linear(d, d),\n            nn.GELU(),\n            nn.Dropout(dropout),\n            nn.Linear(d, n_classes),\n        )\n\n    def forward(self, x):\n        ct = x[:, :2, :, :]\n        pt = x[:, 2:3, :, :]\n\n        f_ct = self.ct_enc(ct)\n        f_pt = self.pt_enc(pt)\n\n        tokens = torch.stack([f_ct, f_pt], dim=1)\n        tokens = self.norm(tokens)\n        out, _ = self.attn(tokens, tokens, tokens, need_weights=False)\n        fused = out.mean(dim=1)\n        return self.head(fused)\n\nif MODEL_TYPE == \"dual_attn\":\n    model = FeatureFusionCrossAttn(BACKBONE, len(TASK_CLASS_NAMES)).to(DEVICE)\nelse:\n    model = EarlyFusionNet(BACKBONE, len(TASK_CLASS_NAMES)).to(DEVICE)\n\nn_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) / 1e6\nprint(\"Model:\", MODEL_TYPE, \"| Params:\", f\"{n_params:.2f}M\")\n\n\n# -----------------------\n# FIXED Loss: class-balanced focal\n# -----------------------\nclass FocalLoss(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, gamma=2.0, weight=None, label_smoothing=0.0):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.gamma = float(gamma)\n        self.label_smoothing = float(label_smoothing)\n\n        # IMPORTANT: use as_tensor so it doesn't accidentally force CPU copies\n        if weight is None:\n            self.register_buffer(\"weight\", None)\n        else:\n            self.register_buffer(\"weight\", torch.as_tensor(weight, dtype=torch.float32))\n\n    def forward(self, logits, targets):\n        # EXTRA SAFETY: always align weight device with logits device\n        w = self.weight\n        if w is not None and w.device != logits.device:\n            w = w.to(logits.device)\n\n        ce = F.cross_entropy(\n            logits, targets,\n            weight=w,\n            reduction=\"none\",\n            label_smoothing=self.label_smoothing\n        )\n        pt = torch.exp(-ce)\n        loss = ((1 - pt) ** self.gamma) * ce\n        return loss.mean()\n\n# ---- FIX: move criterion to DEVICE so its buffer (weight) goes to GPU ----\ncriterion = FocalLoss(gamma=2.0, weight=class_w, GradScaler\n    scaler = GradScaler(enabled=(DEVICE.type==\"cuda\"))\n    AMP_CTX = lambda: autocast(enabled=(DEVICE.type==\"cuda\"))\n\n\ndef softmax_np(x):\n    x = x - x.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n    e = np.exp(x)\n    return e / (e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)\n\n@torch.no_grad()\ndef evaluate_patient_level(model, loader):\n    model.eval()\n    probs_all, y_all, pid_all = [], [], []\n\n    for x, y, pid in loader:\n        x = x.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)\n        logits = model(x).detach().cpu().numpy()\n        probs = softmax_np(logits)\n        probs_all.append(probs)\n        y_all.append(y.numpy())\n        pid_all.extend(list(pid))\n\n    p = np.concatenate(probs_all, axis=0)\n    y = np.concatenate(y_all, axis=0)\n\n    dfp = pd.DataFrame(p, columns=[f\"p{i}\" for i in range(p.shape[1])])\n    dfp[\"y\"] = y\n    dfp[\"pid\"] = pid_all\n\n    agg = dfp.groupby(\"pid\").mean(numeric_only=True)\n    y_pid2 = dfp.groupby(\"pid\")[\"y\"].first().values\n    p_pid  = agg[[f\"p{i}\" for i in range(p.shape[1])]].values\n    y_pred = p_pid.argmax(axis=1)\n\n    acc  = accuracy_score(y_pid2, y_pred)\n    f1m  = f1_score(y_pid2, y_pred, average=\"macro\")\n    bacc = balanced_accuracy_score(y_pid2, y_pred)\n    return acc, f1m, bacc, y_pid2, y_pred\n\ndef train_one_epoch(model, loader):\n    model.train()\n    running = 0.0\n    for x, y, _ in loader:\n        x = x.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)\n        y = y.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)\n\n        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)\n        with AMP_CTX():\n            logits = model(x)\n            loss = criterion(logits, y)\n\n        scaler.scale(loss).backward()\n        scaler.step(optimizer)\n        scaler.update()\n\n        running += float(loss.detach().cpu())\n    return running / max(1, len(loader))\n\n\n# -----------------------\n# Training loop + early stopping\n# -----------------------\nbest_f1 = -1\nbest_path = WORK_DIR / f\"best_{TASK}_{USE_PET}_{FUSION_INPUT}_{MODEL_TYPE}_{BACKBONE}.pt\"\nbad_epochs = 0\n\nfor epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):\n    tr_loss = train_one_epoch(model, train_loader)\n    acc, f1m, bacc, y_true, y_pred = evaluate_patient_level(model, val_loader)\n\n    print(f\"Epoch {epoch:02d}/{EPOCHS} | loss={tr_loss:.4f} | val_acc={acc:.4f} | val_bacc={bacc:.4f} | val_f1={f1m:.4f}\")\n\n    if f1m > best_f1 + 1e-6:\n        best_f1 = f1m\n        bad_epochs = 0\n        torch.save(model.state_dict(), best_path)\n        print(\"  ✓ Saved best:\", best_path)\n    else:\n        bad_epochs += 1\n Traditional fusion baselines (PCA / Laplacian)\n#  - Latency benchmark (real-time objective)\n# ============================================================\n\nimport os, re, math, random, pickle, tempfile, time, warnings, copy\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\nimport cv2\nimport pydicom\nimport xml.etree.ElementTree as ET\n\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nfrom torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader\n\nimport timm\nimport albumentations as A\nfrom albumentations.pytorch import ToTensorV2\n\nfrom sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedShuffleSplit, StratifiedKFold\nfrom sklearn.metrics import (\n    accuracy_score, f1_score, confusion_matrix,\n    balanced_accuracy_score, classification_report,\n    roc_auc_score\n)\n\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\nwarnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\", message=\"ShiftScaleRotate is a special case of Affine transform.*\")\n\n# -----------------------\n# CONFIG (edit here)\n# -----------------------\nDATA_ROOT = Path(\"/kaggle/input/lung-pet-ct-dx\")\nWORK_DIR  = Path(\"/kaggle/working\")\nWORK_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\nSEED = 42\nDEVICE = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n\n# Task:\n#   \"nsclc_vs_sclc\" is the best match to Objective-5 (rare class: SCLC)\n#   \"4class\" is harder and needs CV\nTASK = \"nsclc_vs_sclc\"\n\n# Fusion input (traditional vs deep)\n# \"stack\" / \"pca\" / \"laplacian\"\nFUSION_INPUT = \"stack\"\n\n# Modality mode for ablations:\n# \"fusion\" / \"ct_only\" / \"pet_only\"\nMODALITY_MODE = \"fusion\"\n\n# MIL model type:\n# \"mil_early\" (single encoder on 3ch)\n# \"mil_dual_xattn\" (CT encoder + PET encoder + cross-attn, then MIL pooling)  <-- best\nMODEL_TYPE = \"mil_dual_xattn\"\n\n# Backbone (keep modest; MIL already strong)\nBACKBONE = \"tf_efficientnet_b0_ns\"\n\nIMG_SIZE = 224\nNUM_WORKERS = 2\n\n# Bag settings\nBAG_SIZE_TRAIN = 8\nBAG_SIZE_VAL   = 12\nVAL_BAGS_PER_PATIENT = 8  # bag-TTA aggregation\n\n# Patient batch size (each batch = patients, not slices)\nBATCH_PATIENTS = 6\n\n# Training\nEPOCHS = 25\nLR = 3e-4\nWEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4\nPATIENCE = 6\nGRAD_CLIP = 1.0\n\n# Tumor-centric sampling\nTUMOR_NEIGHBOR_SLICES = 2\n\n# Use CV (publishable) or single split (faster)\nRUN_CV = False\nN_FOLDS = 5\n\nprint(\"DEVICE:\", DEVICE)\nprint(\"DATA_ROOT exists:\", DATA_ROOT.exists())\n\n# -----------------------\n# Reproducibility\n# -----------------------\ndef seed_everything(seed=42):\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    torch.manual_seed(seed)\n    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)\n    os.environ[\"PYTHONHASHSEED\"] = str(seed)\n    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = False\n    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True\n\nseed_everything(SEED)\n\n# -----------------------\n# Cache helpers\n# -----------------------\ndef atomic_pickle_dump(obj, path: Path):\n    path = Path(path)\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=\"tmp_\", suffix=\".pkl\", dir=str(path.parent))\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n            pickle.dump(obj, f, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)\n            f.flush()\n            os.fsync(f.fileno())\n        os.replace(tmp_path, str(path))\n    finally:\n        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):\n            try: os.remove(tmp_path)\n            except: pass\n\ndef safe_pickle_load(path: Path):\n    path = Path(path)\n    if not path.exists():\n        return None\n    if path.stat().st_size < 16:\n        try: path.unlink()\n        except: pass\n        return None\n    try:\n        with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n            return pickle.load(f)\n    except Exception:\n        try: path.unlink()\n        except: pass\n        return None\n\n# \"LargeCellCarcinoma\",\n    \"E\": \"LargeCellCarcinoma\",\n    \"G\": \"SquamousCellCarcinoma\",\n}\n\nFULL_CLASS_NAMES = [\"Adenocarcinoma\", \"SmallCellCarcinoma\", \"LargeCellCarcinoma\", \"SquamousCellCarcinoma\"]\nFULL_CLASS_TO_IDX = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(FULL_CLASS_NAMES)}\n\nPID_RE = re.compile(r\"Lung[_-]?Dx-([ABEGC])\\d+\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\ndef return LABEL_MAP.get(code, None)\n\ndef map_task_label(full_label: str):\n    if full_label is None:\n        return None, None\n\n    if TASK == \"4class\":\n        return FULL_CLASS_TO_IDX[full_label], FULL_CLASS_NAMES\n\n    if TASK == \"nsclc_vs_sclc\":\n        # NSCLC: Adeno + Squamous + LargeCell, SCLC: SmallCell\n        if full_label == \"SmallCellCarcinoma\":\n return None\n\ndef get_z(ds):\n    ipp = getattr(ds, \"ImagePositionPatient\", None)\n    if ipp is not None:\n        try:\n            if len(ipp) >= 3:\n                return float(ipp[2])\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    return None\n\ndef ct_to_hu(ct, ds):\n    slope = float(getattr(ds, \"RescaleSlope\", 1.0))\n    inter = float(getattr(ds, \"RescaleIntercept\", 0.0))\n -----------------------\ndef pca_fuse(a, b):\n    x = np.stack([a.reshape(-1), b.reshape(-1)], axis=1).astype(np.float32)\n    x = x - x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)\n    cov = (x.T @ x) / max(1, 1e-6)\n    return fused.astype(np.float32)\n\ndef laplacian_pyramid_fuse(a, b, levels=3):\n    a = a.astype(np.float32)\n    b = b.astype(np.float32)\n\n    gpA = [a]; gpB = [b]\n    for _ in ct_lung_c[:] = 0.0\n                ct_med_c[:]  = 0.0\n            if MODALITY_MODE == \"ct_only\":\n                pet_c[:] = 0.0\n\n            # fusion input modes\n            if FUSION_INPUT == \"stack\":\n                x = np.stack([ct_lung_c, ct_med_c, pet_c], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)\n            elif FUSION_INPUT == \"pca\":\n                fused = pca_fuse(ct_lung_c, pet_c)\n                x = np.stack([ct_lung_c, fused, pet_c], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)\n            elif FUSION_INPUT == \"laplacian\":\n                fused = laplacian_pyramid_fuse(ct_lung_c, pet_c, levels=3)\n                x = np.stack([ct_lung_c, fused, pet_c], axis=-1).astype(np.float32)\n            else:\n                raise ValueError(\"Unknown FUSION_INPUT\")\n\n            x = np.clip(x, 0, 1)\n\n            if self.tfms is not None:\n                out = self.tfms(image=x)\n                x_t = out[\"image\"]  # (3,H,W)\n            else:\n                x_t = torch.from_numpy(x.transpose(2,0,1))\n\n            x_t = (x_t - IMAGENET_MEAN) / (IMAGENET_STD + 1e-6)\n            bag.append(x_t)\n\n        x_bag = torch.stack(bag, dim=0)  # (K,3,H,W)\n        return x_bag, torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.long), pid\n\n# -----------------------\n# Balanced patient batch sampler\n# -----------------------\nclass BalancedPatientBatchSampler:\n    \"\"\"\n    Yields balanced batches of patient indices.\n    Useful when SCLC is rare.\n    \"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, labels, batch_size, steps_per_epoch, seed=42):\n        self.labels = np.array(labels, dtype=int)\n        self.batch_size = int(batch_size)\n        self.steps = int(steps_per_epoch)\n        self.rng = random.Random(seed)\n\n        self.idx0 = np.where(self.labels == 0)[0].tolist()\n        self.idx1 = np.where(self.labels == 1)[0].tolist()\n\n        if len(self.idx0) == 0 or len(self.idx1) == 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"Balanced sampler needs both classes present in training split.\")\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        return self.steps\n\n    def _sample(self, idxs, k):\n        if len(idxs) >= k:\n            return self.rng.sample(idxs, k)\n        return [self.rng.choice(idxs) for _ in range(k)]\n\n    def __iter__(self):\n        # half-half\n        n1 = self.batch_size // 2\n        n0 = self.batch_size - n1\n        for _ in range(self.steps):\n            b0 = self._sample(self.idx0, n0)\n            b1 = self._sample(self.idx1, n1)\n            batch = b0 + b1\n            self.rng.shuffle(batch)\n            yield batch\n\n# -----------------------\n# MIL Attention Pooling (gated attention)\n# -----------------------\nclass GatedAttnPool(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, d_in, d_attn=256, dropout=0.1):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.V = nn.Linear(d_in, d_attn)\n        self.U = nn.Linear(d_in, d_attn)\n        self.w = nn.Linear(d_attn, 1)\n        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)\n\n    def forward(self, H):\n        \"\"\"\n        H: (B, K, D)\n        returns:\n          M: (B, D) pooled\n          A: (B, K) attention weights\n        \"\"\"\n        Vh = torch.tanh(self.V(H))\n        Uh = torch.sigmoid(self.U(H))\n        A = self.w(self.drop(Vh * Uh)).squeeze(-1)  # (B,K)\n        A = torch.softmax(A, dim=1)\n        M = torch.sum(H * A.unsqueeze(-1), dim=1)\n        return M, A\n\n# -----------------------\n# MIL Models\n# -----------------------\ndef create_backbone(backbone, in_chans, pretrained=True, num_classes=0):\n    try:\n        return timm.create_model(backbone, pretrained=pretrained, in_chans=in_chans, num_classes=num_classes)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(\"⚠️ Pretrained weights unavailable, using pretrained=False.\", e)\n        return timm.create_model(backbone, pretrained=False, in_chans=in_chans, num_classes=num_classes)\n\nclass MILEarlyFusion(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"\n    (B,K,3,H,W) -> per-slice encoder -> (B,K,D) -> gated attention pooling -> logits\n    \"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, backbone, n_classes, dropout=0.2):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.enc = create_backbone(backbone, in_chans=3, pretrained=True, num_classes=0)\n        d = getattr(self.enc, \"num_features\", None) or self.enc.get_classifier().in_features\n        self.pool = GatedAttnPool(d, d_attn=256, dropout=dropout)\n        self.head = nn.Sequential(\n            nn.LayerNorm(d),\n            nn.Dropout(dropout),\n            nn.Linear(d, n_classes)\n        )\n\n    def forward(self, x):\n        B,K,C,H,W = x.shape\n        x = x.view(B*K, C, H, W)\n        f = self.enc(x)           # (B*K, D)\n        f = f.view(B, K, -1)      # (B, K, D)\n        m, attn = self.pool(f)    # (B,D), (B,K)\n        logits = self.head(m)\n        return logits, attn\n\nclass MILDualCrossAttn(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"\n    Dual encoders:\n      CT encoder on (2ch), PET encoder on (1ch)\n    Per-slice cross-attention fusion:\n      tokens = [f_ct, f_pet] -> MHA -> fused feature\n    Then MIL attention pooling across K slices.\n    \"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, backbone, n_classes, heads=8, dropout=0.2):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.ct_enc = create_backbone(backbone, in_chans=2, pretrained=True, num_classes=0)\n        self.pt_enc = create_backbone(backbone, in_chans=1, pretrained=True, nn.MultiheadAttention(d, num_heads=heads, batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)\n\n        self.pool = GatedAttnPool(d, d_attn=256, dropout=dropout)\n\n        self.head = nn.Sequential(\n            nn.LayerNorm(d),\n            nn.Dropout(dropout),\n            nn.Linear(d, n_classes)\n        )\n\n    def forward(self, x):\n        B,K,C,H,W = x.shape\n        x = x.view(B*K, C, H, W)\n\n        ct = x[:, :2, :, :]\n        pt = x[:, 2:3, :, :]\n\n        f_ct = self.ct_enc(ct)   # (B*K, D)\n        f_pt = self.pt_enc(pt)   # (B*K, D)\n\n        tokens = torch.stack([f_ct, f_pt], dim=1)  # (B*K, 2, D)\n        tokens = self.norm(tokens)\n        out, _ = self.xattn(tokens, tokens, tokens, need_weights=False)\n        fused = out.mean(dim=1)  # (B*K, D)\n\n        fused = fused.view(B, K, -1)\n        m, attn = self.pool(fused)\n        logits = self.head(m)\n        return logits, attn\n\n# -----------------------\n# EMA (improves stability)\n# -----------------------\nclass ModelEMA:\n    def __init__(self, model, decay=0.999):\n        self.ema = copy.deepcopy(model).eval()\n        self.decay = decay\n        for p in self.ema.parameters():\n            p.requires_grad_(False)\n\n    @torch.no_grad()\n    def update(self, model):\n        msd = model.state_dict()\n        esd = self.ema.state_dict()\n        for k in esd.keys():\n            if
